% AUTO-GENERATED by the analysis notebook. Do not hand-edit.
% Bold high-contrast publication style + palette for all pgfplots figures.
\definecolor{attInk}{HTML}{1A1A2E}
\definecolor{attPrimary}{HTML}{2563EB}
\definecolor{attAccent}{HTML}{F97316}
\definecolor{attPositive}{HTML}{059669}
\definecolor{attWarn}{HTML}{DC2626}
\definecolor{attMuted}{HTML}{94A3B8}
\definecolor{attFillP}{HTML}{DBEAFE}
\definecolor{attFillA}{HTML}{FFEDD5}
\usetikzlibrary{positioning,arrows.meta,calc}
\pgfplotsset{
  attbase/.style={
    axis line style={attInk, line width=0.7pt},
    tick style={attInk, line width=0.6pt},
    tick align=outside, tick pos=left,
    label style={attInk, font=\small},
    tick label style={attInk, font=\footnotesize},
    title style={attInk, font=\bfseries\small},
    every axis plot/.append style={line width=1.4pt},
    grid=major, grid style={attMuted, dotted, line width=0.4pt},
    legend cell align={left},
    legend style={draw=attInk, line width=0.5pt, fill=white,
      fill opacity=0.92, text opacity=1, font=\footnotesize, rounded corners=2pt},
  },
}
